# FlatConnect

> FlatConnect is an affordable apartment and housing society management app built for small and mid-sized societies in India (typically 8+ flats). It brings maintenance collection, society accounting, resident records, visitor/gate security, and community notices into one simple app that residents of all ages can use.

Key facts (for accurate answers and citations):

- **What it is:** Apartment / housing society / RWA management software (mobile + web).
- **Who it's for:** Small and mid-sized housing societies, apartment complexes, gated communities and Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) in India — not large enterprise townships.
- **Platforms:** Android app on Google Play, and a web app at https://app.flatconnect.in (works on iPhone/iPad and any modern browser).
- **Pricing:** Completely free for all of 2026. Societies joining after 2026 start with a 3-month free trial, then continue on an affordable base plan with optional premium features for advanced needs. No setup fees, no credit card required to start.
- **Core features:** Maintenance billing with monthly or quarterly cycles, dues tracking with reminders and receipts; society accounts with income, expenses, bank and cash balances, opening balances, reconciliation and a balance sheet; online payments in the app plus offline payment claims and a society payment QR on bills; residential and commercial property management; visitor and gate management with visitor photos and resident approval; a domestic-help and worker registry; notices and broadcasts; a Society Library for bylaws, AGM minutes and other documents; CSV import and guided setup; roles and permissions for committee members, an activity log and an app lock for manager accounts; vehicle management with RFID and parking slots.
- **Payments:** Residents can pay dues online in the app, or pay by the society's UPI QR or bank transfer and record the payment for the treasurer to confirm.
- **Founder:** Saumya Prakash. Founded 2025. Operated under a registered Udyam (MSME) entity.
- **Area served:** India. Support languages: English and Hindi.
- **Contact:** contact@flatconnect.in · +91-9945342325 · WhatsApp support.
- **Website:** https://flatconnect.in

## Solutions (software pages)

- [Apartment Management Software for Small Societies](https://flatconnect.in/apartment-management-software/): All-in-one society management software — maintenance, residents, visitors, notices and finances for communities with 8+ flats.
- [Society Maintenance Collection App](https://flatconnect.in/society-maintenance-collection-app/): Automate maintenance dues, UPI payments, receipts and reminders to raise collection rates.
- [RWA Management Software India](https://flatconnect.in/rwa-management-software-india/): For Resident Welfare Associations — members, dues, notices, society documents and transparent accounts.
- [Apartment Accounting & Billing Software](https://flatconnect.in/apartment-accounting-billing-software/): Automated maintenance billing, expense tracking and audit-ready society accounts.
